clips.title: The story
paras: At Camp Taurajo, Jorn Skyseer awaits Ishamuhale's Fang from the feared sunscale raptor Speartooth of the Barrens. The tooth proves the hunter bested one of Kalimdor's deadliest natural predators.

Across the central savanna, hunters fear Ishamuhale, the fiercest sunscale raptor alive. Some say the apex hunter kills from predatory passion, not hunger. Fresh zhevra meat draws the beast into the open beside a withered tree northwest of Ratchet, where it gives no quarter. Taking its massive fang proves to the Horde's hunting instructors that a traveler has overcome the savagery of the plains.
